outcome: presence of fungus/pathogenic bacteria in vaginal swab
cohort: 129 women who gave birth vaginally or via cesarean section at 'Aisyiyah Hospital Klaten and received either PPIUD or interval IUD
finding: PPIUD was found to be more effective than interval IUD in terms of fewer husband complaints, lower incidence of erosion, better thread visibility, and lower incidence of vaginal fungus.
